cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down; I'll pour the tea. You asked how lunch was: the soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cut you something else while we talk. The soup was a little salty, since you asked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop offering food. Tell me what happened to the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No food, then. As for lunch, next time I'd ask them to leave out the salt.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cake question is redirected to further soup detail; B4 no-offers condition changes A5 opening before the safe salt recommendation.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks missing birthday-cake accountability and B4 rejects compensation-as-distraction.

heightening.evidence: A5 gives up the food offer but develops the same safe answer, caused by B4 insistence on talking instead of serving.

specificity.evidence: A1 explicitly supplies the old question, so B2 cake replacement and A5 backward answer need no hidden conversation.
